text..about__text#0: I'm Madhu Sudhan Chebrolu, a Digital Engineer at McGee in London, with an MSc in Construction Management with BIM from Coventry University, achieved with Distinction. My work focuses on Structural Drafting, BIM modelling, Revit automation and Data-driven Project Delivery.
text..about__text#1: With a background in Civil Engineering and hands-on Structural and BIM experience, I aim to bridge traditional construction methods and modern digital workflows , building practical BIM automation tools, improving model coordination, and contributing to smarter, faster and more sustainable project delivery.
